verdict.rationale: a-Shell includes Vim for editing and documents running syntax checkers via vim-lsp or ALE, plus compilers (clang/clang++) that can catch syntax errors on compile. However, there's no first-party dedicated lint tool bundled, and setup of ALE/vim-lsp for linting is left to the user with no concrete walkthrough or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: bundled/native lint tooling beyond vim plugins, hands-on/independent verification that vim-lsp/ALE actually work well in this sandboxed iOS environment.
